verdicts.reason: Both leaderboards break the design the same way. The peach and pasta-pattern background panels have turned into separate boxes, the two hero food photos are shrunk to tiny thumbnails jammed into their top-left corners, and the ornate frame is an empty rectangle. The swash dividers float loose and the headline sits tight against the left and top edges. The only difference is that B nudges the Cascadia/RESTAURANT/URL block slightly, so they are effectively equal and both unusable.
